The '''1927–28 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by five points over nearest rival [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]]. [[Bo'ness F.C.|Bo'ness]] and [[Dunfermline Athletic F.C.|Dunfermline Athletic]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1928–29 Scottish Division Two]].
